text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: ABSTRACTION LEVEL 2 - CROSS-FUNCTIONAL STRATEGIC COLLABORATION. Scope: referral intake and triage, new patient appointment booking, consultation and consent, and clinical authorisation of treatment. Activities are business activities, not keystrokes:

each is attributed to the organisational unit accountable for it, and each carries a documentation element naming the operational sub-process it decomposes into. Only lanes that carry work in this scope are declared.

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: LINK TO THE DETAILED OPERATIONAL MODEL. The operational model O1_Operational_Merged implements this process at task level. Examples of the mapping: T_CheckDocumentation > O1 T_CheckReferralDocuments; T_RequestMissingDocs > O1

T_RequestMissingDocuments (Zeebe job request-missing-documentation, message flow MF_S2); T_QuerySlots > O1 T_QueryAvailableSlots (job query-available-appointment-slots); T_TelephonePatient > O1 T_TelephonePatient (conditional on
appointmentWithin14Days); T_CreateAuthorisedRequest > O1 T_CreateTreatmentBookingRequest. An activity with no operational counterpart is a gap, not an implementation.

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: BUSINESS RULES MODELLED AS GATEWAYS AND CONSTRAINTS. Only an authorised Consultant may judge clinical suitability or accept a referral, and the reason and decision maker must be recorded (T_RecordDecision). A New Patient Appointment may only be

arranged after an authorised acceptance (G_RequestAuthorised and F_A14). The patient must also be telephoned when the appointment is due within 14 days (G_WithinFourteenDays). An appointment is never booked silently outside the period requested by
the Consultant (T_ResolveCapacity). A Treatment Booking Request that is incomplete or unauthorised must not be processed by administrative staff (G_RequestAuthorised).
